content_fields.title: Use file volume encryption and consider in-database encryption with pgcrypto (PostgreSQL)
content_fields.description: Encrypt the database file volume and consider in-database encryption for the most sensitive columns.
content_fields.guidance: The volume holding database files should be encrypted at the storage layer, with pgcrypto used selectively for columns that must stay unreadable even to someone with file access.
content_fields.found: The `pg_volume` Docker volume is unencrypted and no pgcrypto extension is enabled in the migrations.
content_fields.missing: Storage-layer encryption for the volume and a key management arrangement.
content_fields.conclusion: Volume encryption is a storage platform capability configured outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The platform and database administration teams should encrypt the database volume and select columns for pgcrypto.
